source: XPS-100 / PC1001 passive bus observations supplied during hardware analysis
provenance: The target frames come from the complete 30, 34, and 35 C observations in ANALYSIS.md and the live 15 C ESPHome 2026.7.4 hardware log on 2026-08-14. The D1 frame was captured from the passive ESPHome 2026.7.4 hardware log on 2026-08-14. Reconstructed target checksums use the repository's short-frame rule. These are RX-only regression fixtures and do not authorize transmission.

packets.label: PC1001 target 15 C with variable leading setpoint
packets.notes: Live frame proves byte 1 is variable and is not part of the PC1001 signature; byte 2 remains the direct-Celsius heating target.

packets.label: PC1001 target 30 C
packets.notes: Observed short COND_2_B payload; byte 2 is direct Celsius and changes with the physical target.

packets.label: PC1001 target 34 C
packets.notes: Observed short COND_2_B target-byte mapping 0x22 to 34 C.

packets.label: PC1001 target 35 C
packets.notes: Observed target-byte mapping 0x23 to 35 C; byte 7 differs from lower-target observations and is deliberately excluded from variant matching.

packets.label: XPS-100 D1 inlet candidate 35.5 C
packets.notes: After the XPS short-D2 signature is detected, full packet byte 9 uses extended temperature encoding: 0x83 decodes to the inlet candidate 35.5 C. Physical display comparison is still required.
